note: Read-only grounding corpus for the GradientOS agents. Documentation, definitions, and taxonomy only — never raw customer PII or payment data. Shared source of truth for the Python knowledge service and the Node fallback retriever.

documents.title: Spend
documents.text: Spend is the amount the platform charged for delivery in the reporting window. Reported directly by Meta and TikTok. Currency follows the ad account settings.

documents.title: Conversions and results
documents.text: Conversions are the optimized results the platform attributes within the attribution window. Meta labels these results; TikTok labels them conversions. They are platform-attributed, not verified orders.

documents.title: CPA and cost per result
documents.text: CPA, also called cost per result or cost per order, is spend divided by conversions. It is a derived metric computed from base fields, not stored by the platform.

documents.title: CTR, CPC, CPM
documents.text: CTR is clicks divided by impressions. CPC is spend divided by clicks. CPM is spend per thousand impressions. All are derived metrics.

documents.title: ROAS, revenue and sales are unavailable from ad-platform reads
documents.text: ROAS, revenue, sales, profit, and lifetime value cannot be read from an ad platform. Platforms report attributed results, not verified revenue. These require a POS or order-system join such as Toast. Never multiply conversions by an assumed order value to fabricate revenue or ROAS.

documents.title: Attribution window
documents.text: Every metric carries an attribution window, the click and view lookback the platform used to credit a conversion. The default in the preview data is 7-day click and 1-day view. Meta and TikTok can report the same campaign differently depending on the window, so the window must be stated and only matching windows can be compared across providers.

documents.title: Meta account structure
documents.text: Meta hierarchy is ad account, campaign, ad set, ad or creative. The middle level is the ad set, which holds the audience, placement, schedule and budget. Meta optimizes toward results defined by the campaign objective. Placements include Facebook Feed, Instagram Feed, Instagram Reels and Stories.

documents.title: TikTok account structure
documents.text: TikTok hierarchy is advertiser, campaign, ad group, ad or creative. The middle level is the ad group. Access is shared at the advertiser level. Spark Ads use a creator handle. The main placement is the TikTok For You feed.

documents.title: Campaign naming taxonomy
documents.text: Campaign names follow Geography Daypart-or-Offer Funnel-stage, for example Chicago Lunch Prospecting, First Order Offer, Lunch Near You. Funnel tokens include Prospecting, Retargeting and Offer. Daypart tokens include Lunch, Dinner and Late night.

documents.title: Connection onboarding sequence
documents.text: Connecting an account is read-only. The sequence is pre-flight verification, customer OAuth authorization, ad account or advertiser selection, historical sync of metadata and daily insights, then validation of freshness, coverage, timezone, currency and required fields. Until validation passes the connection shows as pending review.

documents.title: Meta access scope
documents.text: Meta uses the Marketing API with Advanced ads_read access. business_management is requested only when account discovery is needed. ads_management is never requested in this MVP. The customer approves ads_read, selects ad accounts and confirms Facebook and Instagram placement coverage.

documents.title: TikTok access scope
documents.text: TikTok uses a Marketing API developer app with reporting and consolidated report access. Server routes are limited to advertiser, campaign, ad group, ad and reporting reads. The customer authorizes with a Business Center user and selects advertiser IDs to share.

documents.title: Data-protection boundary
documents.text: Agents ingest aggregated reporting metrics, object metadata and audience definitions such as interest and geo names. They never ingest raw customer PII, hashed audience match data, or payment and billing details. The knowledge store holds documentation and taxonomy only.
